Format to be agreed during monthly teleconferences; cumulative data presented since the beginning of data collection. The format of the epidemiological data summary will be agreed with ECDC. Communication between the contractor and the countries/sites to validate the data will take place using principles agreed between the contractor and ECDC and periodically revisited.
DL 1.3.10. Regular laboratory results summary table

Production of regular laboratory results summary table to ECDC specifying the number of laboratory specimens processed and tested and the proportion of positive samples by study site, stratified by key variables.
